name: Voyager Electronics Corporation
old_description: Voyager Electronics Corporation, a distributor of electronic components and manufacturer of cable related solutions. Voyager offers a wide variety of components such as circuit protection products, switches, connectors, power supplies, capacitors, audio products and most other electronic component. Since 1982, we have been providing quality products and outstanding customer service, priding ourselves on our ability to bring value, create solutions and support the needs of our customers.
about:
Voyager Electronics Corporation is based in Minneapolis, Minnesota, and was founded in 1982. The company operates as a distributor of electronic components and a manufacturer of cable-related solutions. Ownership details and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The company supplies a broad range of components including circuit protection devices, switches, connectors, power supplies, capacitors, and audio products. In 1997, Voyager established Best Source Electronics Corporation to produce custom cable assemblies, wire harnesses, and provide kitting, custom labeling, and other value-added services. Voyager also offers assembly, engineering, testing, kitting, EDI, and just-in-time delivery programs to reduce customer lead times and inventory.

Voyager serves customers in industrial, medical, aerospace, defense, automotive, IoT, automation, and agriculture sectors. Its client base includes manufacturers of telecom equipment and industrial electrical products. The company partners with component brands such as ZEUS Battery Products, Allied Components, Switch Components Inc., Tenergy Corporation, and Curtis Industries.

Voyager emphasizes value creation through supply-chain consolidation — fewer purchase orders, reduced expediting, and lower packaging waste — and through engineering collaboration on custom solutions such as modified LED displays or medical-grade power supplies. The company maintains ISO 9001:2015 certification and adheres to REACH and conflict-minerals policies.
